text: Golra Railway Station Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Golra Railway Station Type: Monument - Railway Station Province: Islamabad District: Islamabad Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 1857 - 1947 CE Description: Golrha Sharif Railway Station was established by the British in 1882 to connect the area to Havelian, Kohat and Peshawar. The building is constructed with lime stone masonry laid out in lime mortar. The small stone platform is designed in Victoria Style railway station. A museum was established in this building which housed rare items, i.e., watches, navigation equipment, medals, costumes worn by railway staff of British India, photographs, crockery, furniture and other railway accessories.
